questions.q: What is the value of the discriminant for the quadratic equation $2x^2 - 4x + 5 = 0$?

questions.answer: Powers of $i$ repeat every $4$: divide $46 \div 4 = 11$ with remainder $2$. Thus $i^{46} = i^2 = -1$.

questions.q: What are the solutions of the equation $x^2 + 16 = 0$ over the complex numbers?
Find the determinant of the $2 \times 2$ matrix $A = [[4, 3], [2, 5]]$.
For what value of $k$ does the matrix $M = [[k, 6], [2, 3]]$ have NO inverse?
questions.answer: A matrix has no inverse when its determinant is zero: $(k)(3) - (6)(2) = 0 \Rightarrow 3k - 12 = 0 \Rightarrow 3k = 12 \Rightarrow k = 4$.

questions.q: If $A = [[1, 2], [3, 4]]$ and $B = [[2, 0], [1, 3]]$, what is the element in row $1$, column $2$ of $A + 2B$?
What is the remainder when $P(x) = 2x^3 - 4x^2 + 5x - 3$ is divided by $(x - 2)$?
If $(x - 3)$ is a factor of $x^3 - kx^2 + 2x - 6$, what is the value of $k$?
questions.answer: Since $(x - 3)$ is a factor, $P(3) = 0$: $3^3 - k(3^2) + 2(3) - 6 = 0 \Rightarrow 27 - 9k + 6 - 6 = 0 \Rightarrow 27 - 9k = 0 \Rightarrow k = 3$.

questions.q: What is the degree of the polynomial $f(x) = (3x^2 - 1)^2 (x^3 + 4)$?
questions.answer: Degree of $(3x^2 - 1)^2 = 2 \times 2 = 4$. Degree of $(x^3 + 4) = 3$. Total degree $= 4 + 3 = 7$.

questions.q: What is the value of $x + y$ for the system: $3x + 2y = 16$ and $2x - 2y = 4$?
questions.answer: Add both equations: $5x = 20 \Rightarrow x = 4$. Substitute into $2(4) - 2y = 4 \Rightarrow 8 - 2y = 4 \Rightarrow 2y = 4 \Rightarrow y = 2$. Then $x + y = 4 + 2 = 6$.

questions.q: Which point lies in the solution set of the system: $y > 2x - 1$ and $y \leq -x + 4$?
questions.answer: Test $(1, 2)$: $2 > 2(1) - 1 \Rightarrow 2 > 1$ (True), and $2 \leq -1 + 4 = 3$ (True). Thus $(1, 2)$ satisfies both inequalities.

questions.q: If $\frac{x - 3}{x + 2} = 0$, what is the real solution for $x$?
questions.answer: A fraction equals zero when its numerator is zero and denominator is non-zero: $x - 3 = 0 \Rightarrow x = 3$ (with $3 + 2 = 5 \neq 0$).
